answer.reason: Based on EIA Connecticut electricity profile data, IPP & CHP (independent power producers and combined heat/power) account for the vast majority of in-state net generation, while electric utility-owned generation is a very small share. The large value 44,627,596 megawatthours is the IPP & CHP figure.
